caption:
India just rolled out its first privately assembled military aircraft. Built at a Tata-Airbus facility in Gujarat.

Tata Advanced Systems reportedly rolled out the first India-assembled C-295 military transport aircraft from its Vadodara facility in May 2026, part of a Rs 21,935 crore deal for 56 aircraft total - 16 delivered from Spain, 40 to be assembled in India. The Vadodara Final Assembly Line, inaugurated by Prime Minister Modi and Spain's Prime Minister in October 2024, is India's first private-sector final assembly line for a military aircraft. Over 13,000 of the aircraft's roughly 14,000 detailed parts are now reportedly made in India.

16 of these aircraft flew in from Spain. The next 40 are being built here.

Sources: PIB, Aerospace Global News (2024-2026)
